name: Flexi Flick
author: Rashmi Singh

sections.description:
FlexiFlick Slider is a sleek, lightweight, and highly customizable WordPress plugin for building stunning hero banners and dynamic content sliders with ease. Powered by the robust Flickity library, FlexiFlick helps you showcase images, featured posts, or products in a professional, responsive layout — all with minimal setup.

💡 Built for both beginners and advanced users, it integrates seamlessly with the Gutenberg editor, giving you a block-based UI to configure autoplay, navigation arrows, animation speed, styles, and more — all without writing a single line of code.

✨ What’s New in the Latest Version

We’ve rebuilt and optimized the plugin from the ground up to fix critical issues and improve usability:

  • ✅ CSS Fixes for Desktop & Mobile
    Layout and styling issues have been fully resolved across screen sizes.

  • 📱 Touch Slide for Mobile
    Native touch-slide gestures are now supported, making mobile browsing buttery smooth.

  • 🚫 No More Global Loading
    Slider CSS and JS now load only where the block is used, improving performance and avoiding conflicts.

  • 🆕 Advanced Slide Grouping
    Easily create multiple sliders for different pages and assign specific slides to each — giving you full control over content display.

Originally developed in partnership with SiteWired.com, FlexiFlick is built to professional standards while remaining beginner-friendly.

🎉 Download FlexiFlick Slider today and take your website’s visual experience to the next level!

Features:

  • 🎯 New! Slide Group Selection:
    Easily create multiple sliders and assign specific slides to each slider. Perfect for showcasing tailored content on different pages.

  • Hero Banner Ready:
    Highlight important content, featured posts, or product showcases with visually stunning hero banners.

  • Advanced Customization Options:
    Control every aspect of your slider, including navigation, animation speed, autoplay, and pagination, with even more features in development.

  • Seamless Gutenberg Integration:
    Effortlessly create sliders with a block-based interface that’s both intuitive and powerful.

  • Responsive & Mobile-Friendly:
    Your sliders will look amazing on desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.

Source Code

The source code for Flickity JavaScript and CSS files used in this plugin is available here:
– Flickity JS: https://github.com/metafizzy/flickity
– Flickity CSS: https://github.com/metafizzy/flickity
sections.installation:
1. Upload the flexiflick-slider folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.

  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.

  3. Once activated, the plugin will create a new post type called “FlexiFlick Slide” in the backend.

  4. Use this post type to add your desired slide content:
    -The featured image will be used as the slide image.
    -The title and body content will appear as overlay text.

  5. Assign slides to specific slider groups using the “Slider Groups” taxonomy. This allows you to group slides and use different sets of slides for different sliders.

  6. Add the “FlexiFlick Slider” block to your post or page using the Gutenberg editor.

  7. In the block settings, choose the slider group you want to display.

  8. Customize the slider settings in the block inspector, including autoplay, navigation arrows, animation speed, and more.
sections.changelog:
0.1.0

  • Release

0.1.1

  • Added free scroll functionality for a smoother slide experience.
  • Added wrap-around option to allow continuous sliding.
  • Added draggable option to enable/disable manual slide dragging.
  • Added autoPlay speed control, with an option to disable autoplay.
  • Introduced an overlay design option for better visual aesthetics.
  • Added new styles for navigation buttons.

0.1.2

  • changes to make it compatiable with WordPress latest version 6.7
  • added new option to set minimum height for each slide
  • issue fixing for mobile part

0.1.3

  • Added the ability to assign specific slides to individual sliders.
  • Updated Gutenberg block with options to select slider groups.
  • Improved performance and compatibility with the latest WordPress version.
  • Minor UI/UX improvements for block settings.

0.1.4

  • CSS Fixes for Desktop & Mobile
  • No More Global Loading of JS and CSS
